### Added

- **Profile data encryption on Android.** Each profile's message database is encrypted at rest (SQLCipher) with a key in the Android Keystore; existing data is migrated once at startup, with a verified copy. On desktop and in the browser app it is a **preview**. Attachments are **not encrypted yet** (work in progress). Refs #178
- **Privacy & security.** A new screen in the side drawer (desktop and Android apps) holds the lock settings for the whole app instead of each profile's Profile management.
- **App-lock PIN** on desktop, Android and the browser app: Velta asks for it at every start, with growing delays after wrong attempts. The browser app adds a recovery code and passkey unlock.
- **Biometric lock on Android**, with the phone's screen-lock PIN, pattern or password as a fallback on Android 11+ so it also works without enrolled fingerprints. It combines with the Velta PIN ("Use PIN" on the lock screen).
- **Lock when hidden** after 1, 5 or 15 minutes.
- Language cards in the device chat offer Russian or French when your system language differs from the app's.

### Fixed

- Android: the database key was never actually stored, so encryption stayed off; the biometric prompt failed with "did not succeed"; the embedded core no longer re-initializes after it is ready.
- Opening a chat can no longer get stuck for minutes when the core stalls; re-tapping retries.
- Images and videos keep a stable height while they load, so the chat no longer jumps.
- "This message was deleted" is readable in every theme (WCAG AA); the row keeps its height during Undo and then collapses smoothly.

### Changed

- The thread button is icon-only, attached to the bubble corner; the reply count follows the time on all sizes.
- Invite, Cryptex, link-invite and language cards follow the theme tokens and the design-system primary button.

### Under the hood

- Chat-open timing summaries and slow-step/slow-RPC lines in Diagnostics (ids and durations only, no content); biometric failures log the exact prompt error. Attachment encryption is work in progress; until then attachments rely on platform isolation, as Privacy & security says.
